strings.season_theme_strategy_wood: 打断再生并持续输出。每次至多回复初始最大生命2%，整场累计不超过5%；换阶段和恢复房间不重置预算。
strings.season_theme_strategy_fire: 打断蓄力并利用进攻窗口。首领由火木切到金土，不额外追加持续百分比灼烧。
strings.season_theme_strategy_earth: 用破盾和直伤应对周期护盾。护盾受半血上限约束，循环产生的盾也算实际战斗成本。
strings.season_theme_strategy_metal: 观察强化前摇，再选择控制和进攻时机。没有无预警瞬发的大倍率攻击。
strings.season_theme_strategy_water: 在水金与木水阶段间换核、配置混色防御。不以永久断抽或长时间封手拖延战斗。

strings.season_theme_terms: 复用既有地图。40/15是完整怪组的元素偏好输入，双怪整组归一，不代表单怪精确40%。主题不加永久等级或额外全局伤害。

strings.season_theme_strategy_wood: Interrupt regeneration and keep dealing damage. Each cast restores at most 2% of initial maximum HP, with a shared 5% fight budget. Phases and recovery do not reset it.
strings.season_theme_strategy_fire: Interrupt charged attacks and use attack windows. The boss shifts from Fire/Wood to Metal/Earth without extra persistent percentage burns.
strings.season_theme_strategy_earth: Use shield breaking and direct damage against shield cycles. Shield is capped at half maximum HP; recurring gains still count toward combat cost.
strings.season_theme_strategy_metal: Read the empowerment windup, then choose control or attack windows. There are no unannounced instant high-multiplier hits.
strings.season_theme_strategy_water: Switch cores and mixed defenses between Water/Metal and Wood/Water phases. No permanent draw denial or prolonged hand locks.
strings.season_theme_terms: Existing map structure. 40/15 are element preference inputs for whole-group normalization; pairs stay intact, so individual enemies are not exactly 40%. No extra global damage or permanent levels.
